argument: Auxiliary edges in both directions allow signed initial net flow. After obtaining a feasible circulation, delete all artificial residual pairs and augment s to t. Every residual augmentation preserves original internal-node conservation. The original upper-capacity sum bounds the source-cut range, so the additional value fits signed64; lower demands also fit because their sum is no larger. Auxiliary edges have zero lower bound and do not change that demand bound. minimum(s,t) maximizes net flow at t and negates it, preserving the feasible domain and original edge directions. The result is signed, not constrained to be nonnegative. Total upper capacity <= LLONG_MAX excludes LLONG_MIN, so negation is safe.
